Lakers 138Heat 117

Lakers beat the Heat 138–117

Final · Mon, Nov 2 · Los Angeles

Los Angeles beat Miami 138–117, a 21-point home win. The Lakers move to 6–2; the Heat fall to 2–5.

SourcesBox score, game stories and the drawn play

Box score from the Lakers' 138–117 home win over the Miami Heat on Nov 2, 2026, from the league's official stats feed, with game details from the AP (via NBC Miami), Reuters (via Deadspin) and the Miami Herald (via Yahoo Sports). The five scorers shown account for 106 of the 138 points; the rest came from the bench. The Kings' record and the Lakers' conference standing are from the same feed. The playoff odds are from the Box &amp; Motion model (preseason win totals plus results, 60,000 simulations).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Luka Dončić's three that gave him 40 points and put the Lakers up 128–106 with 5:37 left, as reported by Reuters. The recaps don't describe how he got the shot, so it is drawn as a plain pull-up. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.
